meta.title: Multi-select ballot
meta.task: Exercise multi-select questions and option preview rendering

questions.question: How much of the triage flow ships in the first cut?

options.label: Render the board only
options.tradeoff: Ships in one task, but answers still have to be typed back by hand.

options.label: Render plus answer capture
options.tradeoff: Complete loop, but needs a local server and a write path before anything is usable.

questions.question: Which surfaces may open a ballot board?

options.label: frontload
options.tradeoff: The natural home for batched decisions, and already the busiest caller.

options.label: spec BALLOT mode
options.tradeoff: Reuses an existing ballot vocabulary, but its questions are far longer.

options.label: auto pipeline pauses
options.tradeoff: Highest leverage while unattended, but the session is gone by the time anyone answers.

questions.question: What hosting cost is acceptable for the board?

options.label: Local loopback server only
options.tradeoff: Free and private, but unreachable from a phone.

options.label: Tunnel the board to a public URL
options.tradeoff: Answerable from anywhere, but exposes in-flight decisions to the open internet.

defaults.assumption: The board follows the operating system light or dark setting.
defaults.rationale: Matches every other local surface and needs no per-user configuration.

open.question: Should the board be answerable from a phone?
open.why_open: Depends on whether tunnelling is acceptable, which is itself still on this ballot.
